material.title: Acme ships a design-agent mode that turns a prompt into editable components
material.bodyOriginal: Acme today shipped Agent Mode for its design canvas: a prompt produces editable layers and components that follow the file's existing design tokens, available on all paid plans today and on free plans next month, with per-run credit costs published in the pricing page.

material.title: 10 ways AI will change your design morning routine
material.bodyOriginal: AI is everywhere. Here are ten ways it might change how you start your design day, from AI moodboards to AI-planned critiques. Sign up for our course to learn more.
